title: Not engaging in what is right because it isn't what masses do makes sure there is a 0% chance of change. Doing what is right as a model for the masses
summary: Not engaging in what is right because it isn't what masses do makes sure there is a 0% chance of change. Doing what is right as a model for the masses increases the probability by n+1. Small is better than zero. Small can add up to masses. n + 0 equals same.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html: Not engaging in what is right because it isn't what masses do makes sure there is a 0% chance of change. Doing what is right as a model for the masses increases the probability by n+1. Small is better than zero. Small can add up to masses. n + 0 equals same.
